method.handover: two sources disagree when their dates cannot both be true: a quarter covers 3 months, a month 1, a year 12; disagreements under 3 months apart are ignored; lines about one phase, tower or building are skipped
method.limits: A disagreement between two sources is a reason to ask, not a finding: one source may be older, may describe one phase, or may round.
method.not_checked: permit numbers: our records keep one permit number per project, with the source that prints it, so no second value exists to compare yet
method.price: two sources give a "from" price in the same currency that differs by 10% or more (prices change over time: the dates are shown)
method.sources: each fact line of a project record names its source (a bracket at the end, or a prefix such as "press:" or "portals:"); the DLD register record is one more source for Dubai
method.units: two sources give unit counts that differ by 2 or more and by 5% or more; lines about one phase, tower or building are skipped
